question: How is the business doing?
sql:

    -- Overall order volume
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,

    -- Order status breakdown
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled_orders,

    -- Revenue
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS total_gross_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_item_price,

    -- Customers
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS total_customers,

    -- Average review score
    ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score,

    -- On-time delivery rate
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
                     AND o.order_delivered_customer_date <= o.order_estimated_delivery_date
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        ) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
        2
    ) AS on_time_delivery_pct,

    -- Average days to deliver
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
                THEN JULIANDAY(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
            END
        ),
        2
    ) AS avg_days_to_deliver,

    -- Total sellers
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) AS total_sellers,

    -- Total products sold

),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers
    FROM customer_orders
)
SELECT 
    total.total_customers,
    churned.churned_customers,
    total.total_customers - churned.churned_customers AS retained_customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * churned.churned_customers / total.total_customers, 2) AS churn_rate_pct
FROM total, churned

    SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS revenue, SUM(freight_value) AS freight
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),

-- Delivered orders with delivery time
delivered AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS days_to_deliver,
           julianday(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) - julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS days_early  -- positive = early
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),

-- Review scores
reviews AS (
    SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS avg_score
    FROM order_reviews
    GROUP BY order_id
),

-- Payment type counts
payment_types AS (
    SELECT payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS cnt
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY payment_type
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

-- Monthly revenue trend (last 6 full months)
monthly AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                     AS orders,
           ROUND(SUM(ori.revenue), 2)                     AS monthly_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_revenue ori ON o.order_id = ori.order_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN '2018-03' AND '2018-08'
    GROUP BY month
    ORDER BY month
)

-- Summary metrics
SELECT
    -- Volume
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                                                      AS total_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id)                                            AS unique_customers,

    -- Revenue
    ROUND(SUM(ori.revenue), 2)                                                      AS total_item_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(ori.freight), 2)                                                      AS total_freight_collected,
    ROUND(SUM(ori.revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2)                        AS avg_order_value,

    -- Order status breakdown
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered'    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)               AS orders_delivered,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled'     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)               AS orders_canceled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
              / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2)                                      AS cancellation_rate_pct,

    -- Delivery performance (delivered orders only)
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN d.days_to_deliver IS NOT NULL THEN d.days_to_deliver END), 1) AS avg_days_to_deliver,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.days_early >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
              / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.days_to_deliver IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
                                                                                    AS on_or_early_delivery_pct,

    -- Customer satisfaction
    ROUND(AVG(r.avg_score), 2)                                                      AS avg_review_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.avg_score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                             AS orders_with_good_review,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.avg_score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
              / NULLIF(COUNT(r.avg_score), 0), 2)                                  AS good_review_rate_pct

FROM orders o
JOIN customers c          ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN order_revenue ori ON o.order_id = ori.order_id
LEFT JOIN delivered d     ON o.order_id = d.order_id
LEFT JOIN reviews r       ON o.order_id = r.order_id;
